sr_legacy.name: USDA FoodData Central - SR Legacy (April 2018), CSV
sr_legacy.license: CC0 1.0 Universal - "USDA FoodData Central data are in the public domain ... published under CC0 1.0" (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-guide, Licensing section)
sr_legacy.join: sr_legacy_food.csv NDB_number (zero-padded to 5) -> catalog usda.ndb; nutrient.nutrient_nbr mapped with data/usda-nutrients.mjs + FF_EXTRA
sr_legacy.notes: Only cells EMPTY in current foods.json / foods-ext.json. Kept only food_nutrient rows whose derivation source_id is 1, 4, 9 or 10 (= food_nutrient_source codes 1 analytical, 6 aggregated analytical, 12 manufacturer analytical, 13 literature analytical). Skipped 76 imputed/calculated/assumed-zero rows (codes NC, BFSN, FLC, FLA, BFFN, Z, LC). Gains come from 10 curated forms whose SR records were re-analysed between SR28 (2015) and SR Legacy (2018) - kuru_bezelye 16085, italyan_ekmegi 18033, karalahana 11233/11234, plantain 09277, kuru_uzum 09298, zeytin_siyah 09193, badem_sutu 14091, humus 16158, ricotta 01036. NOTE: SR Legacy also changed some values that exist in SR28 for these foods; this file does not override them (decide separately).

iodine.name: USDA, FDA and ODS-NIH Database for the Iodine Content of Common Foods, Release 4.0 (October 2024)
iodine.license: US Government work (USDA ARS / FDA / NIH-ODS), public domain; no restriction stated on the MAFCL Iodine page.
iodine.join: Column "Standard Reference (Foundation Foods) FDC NDB No." : 5-digit SR NDB; a 6-digit number in parentheses is a Foundation Foods ndb, written here as F<6 digits> (catalog convention for F-forms).
iodine.notes: Used the "Per 100g" workbook only (the "Per Serving" workbook is per serving - not used). Values are analytical means of n samples (FDA TDS + USDA). 4 rows with "*" (bread / bun with iodate dough conditioner) skipped: they differ from the generic NDB. 95 rows have no NDB (free text); one exact SR28 name match (Mushrooms, canned, drained solids 11264, ext only) not included - human review. 18 values are 0 = below LOD/RL per source footnote B (measured, not assumed). source_record_id = IOD4:<DB_ID>. Iodine in foods varies strongly with iodized salt/iodophors/dough conditioners - show the n and year range in tooltip if possible.

choline.name: USDA Database for the Choline Content of Common Foods, Release 2 (January 2008)
choline.license: US Government work (USDA ARS), public domain.
choline.join: NDB_No (SR 5-digit). Temporary 98xxx numbers (504 values) skipped: documentation says they are not unique SR numbers.
choline.notes: ASCII NUT_DATA parsed. Ground-beef records (77 values) skipped: documentation says those were estimated with regression equations. Zero = analysed, not detected (documentation p.4). Nutrients: 421 total choline -> choline, 454 betaine -> betaine (existing keys; SR28 already contains most of these, gain only 5 curated cells); 450/451/452/453/455 -> NEW keys choline_free, choline_pc, choline_ptdcho, choline_gpc, choline_sm (mg choline moiety per 100 g). CC (A/B/C) refers to total choline only. Values may differ from SR28 total choline (more samples) - fill only empty cells, never override SR28.

proanthocyanidins.name: USDA Database for the Proanthocyanidin Content of Selected Foods, Release 2.1 (2018)
proanthocyanidins.license: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105), public domain; USDA ARS publication. No licence restriction stated on the MAFCL page; the same ARS special-interest DBs (e.g. Flavonoid 3.3) are catalogued CC0 on data.gov.
proanthocyanidins.join: NDB No (SR28 5-digit) -> catalog form usda.ndb / foods-ext n
proanthocyanidins.notes: Table PA_DAT exported with mdb-export. All 1254 values kept (all carry a confidence code A-D = evaluated analytical literature/USDA data). Zeros (679) = PAs not detected OR trace without LOQ (documentation p.4); trace values with known LOQ were reported as 0.71*LOQ (cannot be identified per record) - say so in tooltip. Monomers removed in R2.1 (they are in Flavonoid DB as catechin/epicatechin). Requires NEW keys pa_dimer, pa_trimer, pa_4_6mer, pa_7_10mer, pa_polymer (mg/100 g fresh edible portion).

purines.name: USDA and ODS-NIH Database for the Purine Content of Foods, Release 3 (September 2026)
purines.license: US Government work (USDA ARS / NIH-ODS), public domain. Table 2 and part of Table 1 are values compiled from published journal articles (sources a-n in sheet Table7); numeric facts, but cite the original papers.
purines.join: FREE TEXT ONLY (no NDB). Exact, case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised match of the food description to SR28 FOOD_DES Long_Desc (trailing footnote digits/symbols stripped); kept only when the description occurs once in the sheet and exactly one SR28 record matches; Table 1 (USDA analytical / North America) preferred over Table 2 (Japan etc.) for the same NDB. NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW: see name_matches_for_review.csv (53 rows).
purines.notes: Sheets Table1 and Table2 only (mg/100 g wet weight edible portion per footnote *). Table3 (alcohol, per 100 mL) and Tables 4-6 (supplements per serving) not used. "ND" cells skipped (not written as 0). Total = source column "Total of 4 Purine Bases". Most curated matches come from Table 2 (Kaneko 2014, Japanese samples) matched to US SR descriptions by name only. Requires NEW keys purine_adenine, purine_guanine, purine_hypoxanthine, purine_xanthine, purines_total (mg).
purines.review: 2026-11-13 B132: 53 ad eşlemesi tek tek incelendi (USDA_PURINE_R3_NAME_MATCHES.csv); "ok" olan 40 satır tam ve tekil SR28 ad eşleşmesi, alındı; yinelenen ve katalogda olmayanlar alınmadı. Tablo 2 değerleri Japonya örnekleri (Kaneko 2014 vb.), ABD kaydına adla eşlendi.
